name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running on November 3, 2026, spending $214.50 for 7 leads at $30.64 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet delivered 10,230 impressions, 152 clicks at a 1.5% click rate, and 7 leads. It is the sole campaign running so far in 2026-11, with all $214.50 of month-to-date spend on Meta.
The 2026-10-05 cohort (19 leads) is mature: 15 were contacted, 5 converted to applicants, 3 filed their application, and 4 were lost after conversion. No hires have been recorded from this group.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 23 leads — 17 contacted, 6 converted, 2 applied, 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge by rates.
The 2026-11-02 cohort has 7 leads with 3 contacted and no conversions yet; it is also too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before converting are not recorded in the system.
